- Part A completed on 2,164 rows: 175 effects flagged. Pearson screen uses coded analytic n only with nested=no; tails absent assumes two and is explicitly labelled. No project success rule yet established, so no significance-based success flags.

It activates only after all first-pass batches are dispatched, includes only terminal effects with genuinely changed locators and a previously locator_insufficient affected side, archives old checkpoints, and allows one revisit preserving all completed fields. Unchanged paper misses are never retried. Revisit records use attempt2, preventing another automatic retry.
- Locator revisit protection is now enforced in code: comparisons retain all previously completed sides/verdicts while a child runs, and terminal revisit checkpoints are merged back atomically. Only previously locator_insufficient sides can change; unavailable-paper sides and other completed/terminal sides remain unchanged. Added a checkpoint-preservation regression test; eighteen tests pass.
- Missing coded values handled consistently across n, ES and p: if a matching primary source supplies the requested statistic, a blank shipped field becomes an adjudication candidate, not an automatic error. A missing metric label remains not comparable. Confirmed omissions are labelled separately in error records/report, while other blanks stay unverified. This extends the already-used p-omission rule consistently to n/ES. Nineteen tests pass.
- Unblinded Argon adjudication prompts now include field-specific coding provenance (es_repr calculation/direction notes, tails, nesting), never supplied to blind extraction workers. This allows documented transformations/sign directions to be judged rather than mistaken for transcription errors. Scanned existing confirmed ES errors for explicit reversal/direction notes; output reviewed before adding further sign resolutions.

- Clarification of uncertain-target routing: applies to the three statistical fields on a side. reported_success retains its independent done/confident narrative assessment; an unidentifiable numerical test does not by itself invalidate a clearly identified author verdict for the named study/outcome. The first integration briefly inherited statistical target_match=null into success as well, unnecessarily withdrawing147 otherwise evaluable effects and queuing their narrative evidence; this was corrected before the next committed checkpoint. No target-uncertain statistic is automatically verified and known-false targets still receive adjudication.

- Count-format QC:91 n fields were not_comparable solely because blind sample counts used comma thousands groups (e.g.1,950 versus1950). Added analytic_n normalisation limited to unambiguous grouped positive-integer counts (commas/standard narrow spaces); no ES or p decimal convention is reinterpreted, and multi-count strings remain uncomparable. Raw values remain unchanged. True count discrepancies now follow exact/near/differ and adjudication. PartA/flag-confirmation use the same count parser.27 tests pass.
